keywords: 原生 AA 提案 EIP-7701 被标记停滞
summary: eth-bot 对原生 AA 提案 EIP-7701 发起停滞标记。aztecnetwork 称代币销售共 19,476 ETH、16,741 名参与者，一半资金来自 Aztec 社区。mudgen 的 ERC-8042 进入 Final 并合并。周末动态较少。

keywords_en: Native AA proposal EIP-7701 flagged stagnant
summary_en: eth-bot flagged native AA proposal EIP-7701 as stagnant. aztecnetwork said its token sale drew 19,476 ETH from 16,741 participants, half from the Aztec community. mudgen's ERC-8042 moved to Final, merged. A quiet weekend.
